ddl.where: "environment"."provenance" IS NOT NULL AND "environment"."detached_at" IS NULL

ddl.value: "provenance" IS NULL OR json_extract("provenance", '$.kind') <> 'account' OR json_extract("provenance", '$.accountId') = "account_id"

ddl.value: "detached_at" IS NULL OR ("provenance" IS NOT NULL AND "detached_at" >= 0)

ddl.value: "detached_at" IS NULL OR ("provenance" IS NOT NULL AND "detached_at" >= 0)

ddl.value: length("type") > 0 AND substr("type", 1, 1) GLOB '[a-z]' AND "type" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND "type" NOT LIKE '%--%' AND "type" NOT LIKE '%-'
ddl.name: role_permission_name_0

ddl.value: length("name") > 0 AND substr("name", 1, 1) GLOB '[a-z]' AND "name" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND "name" NOT LIKE '%--%' AND "name" NOT LIKE '%-'
ddl.name: role_permission_name_1

ddl.value: "device_id" IS NULL OR "user_id" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: preference_device_user

ddl.value:
("kind" = 'oauth' AND "installation_id" IS NULL AND "secret_space_id" IS NOT NULL AND "secret_id" IS NOT NULL)
            OR ("kind" = 'installation' AND "installation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "secret_space_id" IS NULL AND "secret_id" IS NULL)
ddl.name: connection_authorisation

ddl.value:
length("provider") > 0 AND length("issuer") > 0
            AND length("subject") > 0 AND length("application_id") > 0
            AND ("installation_id" IS NULL OR length("installation_id") > 0)
ddl.name: connection_identifiers

ddl.value: length("type") > 0 AND substr("type", 1, 1) GLOB '[a-z]' AND "type" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND "type" NOT LIKE '%--%' AND "type" NOT LIKE '%-'
ddl.name: personal_access_token_permission_name_0

ddl.value: length("name") > 0 AND substr("name", 1, 1) GLOB '[a-z]' AND "name" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND "name" NOT LIKE '%--%' AND "name" NOT LIKE '%-'
ddl.name: personal_access_token_permission_name_1

ddl.value: "service_account_id" IS NULL OR "account_id" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: oauth_client_service_account

ddl.value: ("accepted_by" IS NULL) = ("accepted_at" IS NULL) AND ("accepted_at" IS NULL OR ("revoked_at" IS NULL AND "accepted_at" >= "created_at" AND "accepted_at" < "expires_at"))
ddl.name: organisation_invitation_acceptance

ddl.value: ("kind" = 'device' AND "device_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("kind" = 'cloud' AND "device_id" IS NULL)

ddl.value:
("network_policy_id" IS NULL AND "network_policy_region_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("network_policy_id" IS NOT NULL AND "network_policy_region_id" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.value:
("package_policy_id" IS NULL AND "package_policy_region_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("package_policy_id" IS NOT NULL AND "package_policy_region_id" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.value: ("kind" = 'personal' AND "user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "organisation_id" IS NULL) OR ("kind" = 'organisation' AND "user_id" IS NULL AND "organisation_id" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.value: length("handle") BETWEEN 1 AND 63 AND "handle" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND "handle" NOT LIKE '-%' AND "handle" NOT LIKE '%-'

ddl.value: length("name") BETWEEN 1 AND 63 AND "name" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND "name" NOT LIKE '-%' AND "name" NOT LIKE '%-'

ddl.value: length("name") BETWEEN 1 AND 63 AND "name" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND "name" NOT LIKE '-%' AND "name" NOT LIKE '%-'

ddl.value: "provenance" IS NULL OR json_extract("provenance", '$.kind') <> 'account' OR json_extract("provenance", '$.accountId') = "account_id"

ddl.value: "provenance" IS NULL OR json_extract("provenance", '$.kind') <> 'stack' OR json_extract("provenance", '$.spaceId') = "space_id"
ddl.name: route_provenance_space

ddl.value: "detached_at" IS NULL OR ("provenance" IS NOT NULL AND "detached_at" >= 0)
ddl.name: route_provenance_detached

ddl.value: ("kind" = 'application' AND "space_id" IS NOT NULL AND "installation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "entrypoint" IS NOT NULL AND "redirect" IS NULL AND "redirect_status" IS NULL) OR ("kind" = 'redirect' AND "space_id" IS NULL AND "installation_id" IS NULL AND "entrypoint" IS NULL AND "redirect" IS NOT NULL AND "redirect_status" IN (301, 302, 303, 307, 308) AND "redirect_status" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: route_destination

ddl.value: length("name") > 0 AND substr("name", 1, 1) GLOB '[a-z]' AND "name" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'
ddl.name: environment_name

ddl.value: "provenance" IS NULL OR json_extract("provenance", '$.kind') <> 'account' OR json_extract("provenance", '$.accountId') = "account_id"
ddl.name: environment_provenance_account

ddl.value: "detached_at" IS NULL OR ("provenance" IS NOT NULL AND "detached_at" >= 0)
ddl.name: environment_provenance_detached

ddl.value: length("directory") > 0 AND substr("directory", 1, 1) <> '/' AND "directory" <> '..' AND "directory" NOT LIKE '../%' AND "directory" NOT LIKE '%/../%' AND "directory" NOT LIKE '%/..'

ddl.value: ("accepted_at" IS NULL) = ("accepted_by" IS NULL) AND ("accepted_at" IS NULL OR ("accepted_at" >= "created_at" AND "accepted_at" < "expires_at" AND "revoked_at" IS NULL))
ddl.name: account_invitation_acceptance
